stories.title: MeowFactory - Official Launch Trailer - IGN
stories.summary: Take a look at gameplay and more from MeowFactory in this launch trailer for this strategy sim game. Build factories and automate production lines to meet the needs of lazy humans in MeowFactory, available now on PC.In the not-so-distant future, after a nuclear and climate disaster, humans have completely surrendered control of the planet to an AI government, leading to the collapse of human civilization. Plants have been destroyed, and humans have lost both the skills and the desire to work in industrial enterprises, bringing everyone to the brink of starvation. However, there is a solution! The Meow-X Corporation presents a new concept for survival: MeowFactory! Instead of humans, it is the cats who will take on all the production responsibilities! As the head of the facility, it is up to you to lead and train them! Just remember, it is not as simple as it may seem.
